data.body:
Triage re-verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887 — STILL OPEN, and I ticked NOTHING, because this ticket's ACs are unsatisfiable as written.

The remediation target no longer exists. Commit 381f6bb9d5a6f320d2fda9ae124f0e38ee192fb9 ('refactor: dead-code removal + low-severity hygiene (S8)') deleted the four dead bridge_fsck.enumerate_{stale,duplicate,open_count_skew,orphan}_anomalies functions (~207 LOC), explicitly noting they had zero references in src/tests/docs and that one of them did an in-process 'from rebar_reconciler import acli' that always failed in-process; the live entry point is audit_bridge_mappings. Confirmed on the current tree:
- 'grep -rn "enumerate_open_count_skew_anomalies" src/rebar tests' -> zero matches.
- 'grep -rn "Acli\|JIRA_\|enumerate_" src/rebar/_engine_support/bridge_fsck.py' -> zero matches.
- 'grep -rn AcliClient src/rebar/_engine_support/' -> zero matches.

Against the ACs one at a time:
- AC1 ('bridge_fsck's AcliClient url/user/project come from load_config().jira.*; JIRA_API_TOKEN stays env-only') — UNSATISFIABLE: there is no AcliClient construction in bridge_fsck to route.
- AC2 ('a test asserts a [tool.rebar.jira] file value reaches that consumer, or document why it stays env-only') — UNSATISFIABLE: the consumer it names is gone, so neither branch has a subject.
- AC3 ('no new _engine_support -> rebar_reconciler import coupling unless justified') — vacuously true (no coupling was added), but ticking a vacuous criterion would misrepresent the ticket as delivered.

The underlying consistency gap this ticket describes was therefore not FIXED, it was DISSOLVED by deleting the dead code. That is an obsolete-disposition decision, not a completion, and it needs an operator: either close it as obsolete/superseded-by-deletion with a link to whatever tracked the S8 dead-code removal, or rewrite the ACs to assert the absence (e.g. an AC that bridge_fsck contains no direct JIRA_* environ reads) and re-run review-plan.

No --force / --force-close was used, and no checkbox was ticked.
